story_title: As Technical Support Staff, I want to review and update equipment requests so that equipment arrangements accurately reflect what can be provided

acceptance_criteria.text: Technical Support Staff can view equipment requirements for an event.
Technical Support Staff can update the fulfilment status of requested equipment.
Technical Support Staff can indicate when equipment cannot be provided.
Technical Support Staff can record relevant technical information.
Updates are associated with the relevant event.

Event 'Robotics Expo' (2027-08-02, status 'Planning') has two equipment lines recorded by its Coordinator:
- 2x Wireless Presenter, technical requirements 'Must pair with the stage laptop over USB-C'
- 3x Confidence Monitor, technical requirements 'Floor wedges facing the speaker, HDMI from the lectern'
Data: run `npm run fixtures:spm50` first.
Logged in as Technical Support Staff (vikram.nair@connectsphere.com, password123).
steps: Click Equipment Requests in the side menu
Find the Robotics Expo row in the list
Open the equipment request for the Robotics Expo event
Read the Wireless Presenter line
Read the Confidence Monitor line
test_cases.test_data:
Event: Robotics Expo
Lines: Wireless Presenter x2, Confidence Monitor x3
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: The Robotics Expo row shows 'Equipment lines' = 2.
Step 3: The Equipment request page opens with the heading 'Equipment request' and the subtitle 'Robotics Expo · ' followed by the event's date and time.
Step 4: The line shows 'Wireless Presenter', Requested 2, its Status chip, and 'Technical requirements: Must pair with the stage laptop over USB-C'.
Step 5: The line shows 'Confidence Monitor', Requested 3, its Status chip, and 'Technical requirements: Floor wedges facing the speaker, HDMI from the lectern'.

test_cases.title: Reserved and Partially fulfilled cannot be chosen by hand, and a reserved line can only become 'Cannot be provided'
test_cases.preconditions:
Rule (team decision): 'Reserved' and 'Partially fulfilled' mean stock is held, so only the Reserve button (SPM-49), which checks availability, can set them. Leaving them releases stock, so a reserved line can only be marked 'Cannot be provided' (with a reason, TC07).
Robotics Expo's Wireless Presenter line is 'Requested'. Charity Briefing's Mobile Charging Cart line is 'Reserved' (Reserved = 1).
Data: run `npm run fixtures:spm50` first.
Logged in as Technical Support Staff (vikram.nair@connectsphere.com, password123).
steps: Open the equipment request for the Robotics Expo event
On the Wireless Presenter line, click 'Update'
Open the 'Fulfilment status' list
Click 'Cancel'
Click Equipment Requests in the breadcrumb and open the Charity Briefing event
On the Mobile Charging Cart line, click 'Update'
Open the 'Fulfilment status' list
test_cases.test_data: Lines: Wireless Presenter (Requested), Mobile Charging Cart (Reserved, Reserved = 1)
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 3: The list offers 'Requested', 'Under review' and 'Cannot be provided' only. 'Reserved' and 'Partially fulfilled' are not offered. The Reserve button remains on the line.
Step 7: The list offers 'Reserved' (the current status) and 'Cannot be provided' only. 'Requested' and 'Under review' are not offered.

test_cases.title: Marking an item 'Cannot be provided' without a real reason is blocked
test_cases.preconditions:
Rule (team decision): a reason is required when equipment cannot be provided, so the Coordinator knows why and can plan around it (Q&A #90).
Robotics Expo's Confidence Monitor line is 'Requested'.
Logged in as Technical Support Staff (vikram.nair@connectsphere.com, password123).

On the Confidence Monitor line, click 'Update'
In 'Fulfilment status', choose 'Cannot be provided'
Leave 'Technical notes' empty

Fulfilment status: Cannot be provided
Technical notes: (empty), then '   ' (3 spaces)

test_cases.title: Marking a reserved line 'Cannot be provided' releases its units, and reserving it again clears the old reason
test_cases.preconditions:
Rule: only lines with status 'Reserved' or 'Partially fulfilled' count against stock, so changing the status to 'Cannot be provided' frees the units by itself.
'Mobile Charging Cart' has 1 unit in total.
Event 'Charity Briefing' (2027-08-23) has 1x Mobile Charging Cart already 'Reserved' (Reserved = 1).
Event 'Charity Gala' (same date, overlapping times) requests 1x Mobile Charging Cart, status 'Requested'.
Data: run `npm run fixtures:spm50` first, and again before repeating the case.
Logged in as Technical Support Staff (vikram.nair@connectsphere.com, password123).
steps: Open the equipment request for the Charity Gala event
Read the Mobile Charging Cart line
Click Equipment Requests in the breadcrumb and open the Charity Briefing event
On the Mobile Charging Cart line, click 'Update'
In 'Fulfilment status', choose 'Cannot be provided'
In 'Technical notes', enter the test data
Click 'Save'
Go back to the Charity Gala equipment request
Go back to the Charity Briefing equipment request
Click Reserve on the Mobile Charging Cart line
test_cases.test_data:
Technical notes: Cart battery failed inspection, cannot be sent out
Mobile Charging Cart: 1 in total
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: Charity Gala's line shows '1 total − 0 in maintenance − 1 reserved elsewhere = 0 available' and the Availability chip 'None available', with 'Held by Charity Briefing (1 unit)'.
Step 7: Charity Briefing's line shows the Status chip 'Cannot be provided'.
Step 8: Charity Gala's line now shows '1 total − 0 in maintenance − 0 reserved elsewhere = 1 available' with the Availability chip 'Available'. Charity Briefing is no longer listed as holding it, and the Reserve button is offered.
Step 10: 'Reservation saved: 1 reserved.' appears. The Status chip shows 'Reserved', the Reserved box shows 1, and the line shows 'Technical Support notes: —': the old reason 'Cart battery failed inspection, cannot be sent out' is cleared, because it no longer holds.

open_questions: OPEN - screen design (TC02–TC14): built as an 'Update' panel on each line of the Equipment request page, with 'Fulfilment status' and 'Technical notes' fields and Save / Cancel. Messages such as 'Update saved.', 'Give a reason when equipment cannot be provided.', 'Technical notes must be 500 characters or fewer.' and 'Last updated by …' are our own wording. No AC constrains the design, so the team should confirm it.

DECIDED (Janelle, 2 Oct) - Reserve stays on a line marked 'Cannot be provided': if stock frees up, Technical Support can reserve it in one click. Reserving it clears the old 'cannot be provided' reason, so the line never shows 'Reserved' next to a reason that no longer holds (TC07; reserveClearsStaffNotes() in src/lib/equipmentFulfilment.ts, used by the SPM-49 reserve route).

DECIDED (Janelle, 2 Oct) - no link from the Equipment request page back to the event. The page shows everything Technical Support needs (the Coordinator's requirements, status, notes), and no test case depends on the link.

OPEN - Coordinator changes a quantity after review or reservation (Q&A #114): should the line return to 'Requested' / 'Under review' so it is re-checked? This crosses into SPM-34 / the change-request flow. No case will be written until ownership is settled.

OPEN (answered by customer Q&A #19) - fulfilment status vs approve/reject (Kristen's comment on the ticket): venue booking has request then approve/reject (SPM-42 then SPM-43), but equipment goes record, check, reserve (SPM-47, 48, 49) with fulfilment statuses. Every story in the SPM-47 to SPM-50 chain is written against the fulfilment-status model, so switching would mean revisiting ACs on shipped stories. Team to confirm the divergence is intentional; meanwhile these cases follow the model already used across the chain. Customer Q&A #19 asked whether equipment has a formal request → approval workflow like venue booking: the answer is that the Coordinator records the requirement, Technical Support reviews suitability and availability, and available equipment can then be reserved - no approval step.

DECIDED (Kristen, 3 Oct, following the BPMN) - Technical Support sees an event's equipment only in Planning and Confirmed (TECH_SUPPORT_EQUIPMENT_STATUSES): the BPMN's Technical Support lane starts after the Coordinator's 'Record equipment request', with 'Check equipment availability' and 'Reserve equipment' in Planning and 'Prepare equipment' in Confirmed. Checking, reserving and updating happen in Planning only; Confirmed is read-only (TC13). Before Planning - including Approved, when the Coordinator has not started - and after it (postponed, cancelled, rejected, completed) the event is not listed and a direct link says it is not found (TC14). Not in SPM-48/49/50's ACs: a process alignment, applied to all three; supersedes the earlier 'Approved onwards' rule and the Reserve gap.

DECIDED (Janelle, 2 Oct) - labels: the request status 'unavailable' is shown as 'Cannot be provided' (Technical Support's decision) and the availability result 'unavailable' as 'None available' (no stock free for those dates), so the two never read the same on one line. Only the displayed text changed; the stored value is still 'unavailable'. Differs from the S-25 mockup, which says 'Unavailable'. SPM-48/49 expected results updated to match.

DECIDED - hand-pickable statuses (TC02, TC03): 'Reserved' and 'Partially fulfilled' are set only by the Reserve button, which keeps Reserved = the smaller of requested and available everywhere (the SPM-49 rule). 'Requested' can be chosen to undo 'Under review'. A Reserved or Partially fulfilled line cannot be moved back to 'Requested' or 'Under review'; leaving it goes through 'Cannot be provided' with a reason.

DECIDED - reason for 'Cannot be provided' (TC06, TC09): required, as Q&A #90 needs text the Coordinator can act on. Technical notes are capped at 500 characters to match SPM-55's out-of-service reason.

DECIDED - releasing stock when a line is marked 'Cannot be provided' (TC07): availability counts only lines with status 'reserved' or 'partially_fulfilled' (committedQuantity in src/lib/equipmentAvailability.ts), so the status change alone frees the units, whatever is left in quantityReserved. TC07 therefore checks the other event's availability, not the stored field. Clearing quantityReserved when marking 'Cannot be provided' is still recommended as data hygiene, so no row reads 'unavailable' with 1 reserved, but it is not needed for correctness.

DECIDED - technical notes storage (TC08, TC10): stored in the existing EquipmentRequest.staffNotes column, separate from the Coordinator's technicalRequirements. The assigned Coordinator and the owning Organiser see them read-only.
ANSWERED, out of scope - notifying the Coordinator when an item is marked 'Cannot be provided' belongs to the batched notification story, so no case is written here (same position as SPM-49).
BUILT (AC1) - the Equipment request page now shows each line's 'Technical requirements' from the Coordinator, 'Technical Support notes', and 'Last updated by' (TC01, TC08, TC08).

Test data - `npm run fixtures:spm50` (scripts/seed-spm50.ts) creates or resets the SPM-50 events: Robotics Expo, Design Week, Charity Briefing, Charity Gala, Confirmed Launch, Pending Showcase and Approved Briefing (Aug-Sep 2027, assigned Coordinator daniel.tan, Robotics Expo owned by Rachel Ng). prisma/seed.ts creates the same rows. Run the script again before repeating any case that saves a change.
